kai: Quick Q — anyone have the EU service-overview + model-health tiles shortlink? Trying to investigate a p95 spike for p-bert (eu-west) but I keep getting a 403. Also opened a PR to add a tile; want to validate alerts before merging.

priya: Which shortlink? paste it here. The usual entry is under the EU ops workspace (Grafana).

kai: Thanks — it's this one: https://grafana.redwood-internal.com/d/abcd1234/service-overview?orgId=2 — that's the URL returning 403 for me.

luca: 403 usually RBAC. Are you signed into the EU org? Try the org switch at top-right. If still 403, ping eng-platform or use the self-serve flow: https://id.redwood-internal.com/grafana-access-request

jenna: I've granted Viewer to kai in the eu-obsv workspace — should propagate in ~1min. @kai check again and confirm.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Created ticket RWD-INC-2026 for grafana access request and notified eng-platform.

kai: Rechecked after ~90s — still 403. Might be folder-level restriction (the tile lives in folder 'model-health/eu'). My PR is #3425 (adds a tile). Also want to tweak the alert: current p95 threshold = 450ms but I observed sustained ~600ms for ~10m at 03/12 14:10 UTC. Proposal: raise threshold to 650ms OR make alert fire only when p95 > 600ms AND error-rate > 0.5%.

priya: Drop the Loki query you used and the exact spike window. We can use that to reproduce.

kai: Loki query I'm using:
```
{app="inference-service",region="eu-west",model="p-bert"} | json | duration>0
| unwrap duration | histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(duration_bucket[5m]))
```
Spike roughly between timestamps 1715010000 - 1715010600 (approx).

luca: For alert tuning I'd prefer a combined rule: alert when p95 > 600ms for 10m OR when there's a 5m spike AND error-rate > 2x baseline. Add a cooldown/evaluation period to avoid flapping. If you include this change in the PR, add the rationale and test plan.

jenna: I still see folder-level restrictions; escalated in the ticket to eng-platform. For now I can share a temp preview shortlink (expires in 24h): https://grafana.redwood-internal.com/d/preview/eu-model-health/abcd-temp — try that.

kai: Temp link works, thanks — I can see the model tiles. I'll update PR with the alert rule and the Loki query, and set dashboard refresh to 30s for the canary run. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/obs-web/merge_requests/3425

ops-bot: ops-bot: Linked PR 3425 to incident RWD-INC-2026 and added labels [observability, access-needed].

priya: :thumbsup: Once the PR is up I'll coordinate a quick canary deploy to validate alert behavior. @luca can you review the alert rule?

luca: Will review today. Suggest making the p95 threshold a dashboard variable so on-call can tweak without a code change.

kai: Good idea — will add a var and update the runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Model+Health+Runbook

jenna: Access ticket updated — eng-platform assigned to @maria, ETA ~2 hrs.

kai: Thanks all — continuing work in PR thread. Will close this Slack thread after merge.
